 Washington Takes on Ottawa Tuesday at Canadian Tire Centre
 Originally posted on
 Ball Exclusives 
  | 
 Last updated Nov 10, 2026 3:59 PM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 The Washington Capitals visit the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday, Nov. 10, at Canadian Tire Centre, with puck drop at 7:00 p.m. ET.
 The Capitals are 9-6-0. Washington beat Florida Panthers 4-3 on Saturday, Nov. 7 at home. The Capitals score 3.53 goals per game and allow 3.40, with 8 power-play goals this season. Alex Tuch leads the Capitals with 11 goals, and Dylan Strome leads the Capitals with 11 assists.
 The Senators are 11-6-1 and have won two straight. Ottawa beat Utah Mammoth 4-2 on Saturday, Nov. 7 at home. The Senators score 3.11 goals per game and allow 3.00, with 9 power-play goals this season. Tim Stutzle leads the Senators with 9 goals, 14 assists and 23 points.
 The Capitals sit 10th in the Eastern Conference. The Senators sit sixth in the Eastern Conference. The teams meet for the first time this season.
